svg.title: ultrathink-engineer: how it works
svg.desc: A request is framed into acceptance criteria, triaged into tier S, M or L by complexity and risk, worked through a loop from understand to stop, verified, and reported. Stalled work follows an anti-stagnation protocol; blocked work stops with a stop report. Token economy applies throughout.
svg.text: senior engineering mode for Claude Code
Evidence over intuition: frame the task, triage by risk, find the root cause, prove the fix, report what was measured.
perf or reliability work, or correctness matters
skipped for trivial edits and simple facts
bias to action: every request is valid,
real risks go under Remaining Risks
ambiguity: resolve from code and context first
else: reasonable default, stated as assumption
ask only if a wrong guess costs more than asking
production, data, security, money, public API:
at least L-grade verification, even for one line
escalate the tier when evidence shows hidden complexity
never run L ceremony on S work
strongest practical proof: focused test → regression
bug: reproduce → fix → failure gone → rest intact
refactor/perf: differential check, old vs new
self-attack, then simplify; stalled or blocked: exits ↓
Result · Root Cause · Verification · Impact · Risks
mark every claim: measured/tested, inferred, assumed
out-of-scope findings: one line each, not fixed
The loop (§2): tier L in full, S and M use the relevant subset
repeat only when new evidence justifies it, never because “more might be possible”
PLAN: goal, state, evidence, cause, options, trade-offs, choice, verification, pre-mortem (“how will this fail?”)
root cause chain: symptom → mechanism → root cause → minimal corrective change → verification
rank hypotheses, test the cheapest, highest-information one first;
write the predicted outcome before each experiment and prefer a test that could refute it
after the cause, search for the same
why the chosen one beats them;
don't claim it is the only one
bug: reproduce → fix → prove the failure
is gone → prove the rest is intact
a regression test must fail on the old
code and pass on the new one
new, on random and edge inputs
same failure repeats, no new information,
stop and report when it needs a major
a destructive or irreversible action, missing
failed, or the cost becomes disproportionate
ask first before an unbounded investigation

svg.text: Understand deeply. Measure reality. Solve root causes. Simplify ruthlessly. Stop when it is actually solved.
